subject: Draft: Role lattice announcement + Q4 OKR check-in & QBR talking points
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: Role lattice announcement + Q4 OKR check-in & QBR talking points

Team —

Attaching a working draft of the communication we plan to share company-wide during the first week of the QBR cycle. Two parallel asks: (1) confirm the role-lattice language and visuals, and (2) review the OKR alignment bullets so leaders have consistent speaking points.

High level context: we are simplifying manager spans and introducing a clearer IC ladder (L4–L7) with updated promotion criteria. This is intended to reduce friction in cross-team staffing and clarify expectations ahead of the Q4 product push.

Specific requests by EOD today if possible:
- Feedback on the wording in section "What changes and why" (attached PDF)
- Any legal/comp concerns we should flag before sending broadly (I can loop Legal if needed)
- Voting on whether to include the org-chart image in the all-hands slide (currently included as org-chart-proposed.png)

Attachments: role-lattice-v2.pdf, org-chart-proposed.png, qbr-talking-points-v1.docx

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Head of People Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: role-lattice-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Role lattice announcement + Q4 OKR check-in & QBR talking points

Priya —

Quick read-through notes: solid framing. A couple of edits:
- "What changes and why": suggest adding one sentence tying the lattice to "faster staffing for priority projects" — executives will want to call that out.
- Org-chart: I favor showing the simplified chart in the all-hands, but keep a more detailed version on the Confluence page for managers.

One risk to call out to Legal: compensation band language. If we say "standardized bands" we should be clear whether changes are retroactive. If we plan to phase in, add that note.

Happy to take the lead on the slide for the all-hands.

Best,
Laura
VP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Draft: Role lattice announcement + Q4 OKR check-in & QBR talking points

Thanks — quick product/eng perspective:
- Please add an explicit "who to contact for questions" list (Eng leads, People ops contact, and CS) to avoid 1:1 escalation overload.
- Suggest we align one bullet under OKRs that calls out "maintain latency targets through holiday spikes" so engineering has a visible mandate.

Minor wording: change "manager layers" -> "leadership layers" to sound less pejorative.

-Markus
Director, Platform Eng

Agree with Markus. A couple of additions from my side:
- Add a short FAQ (3–4 q's) addressing promotion timelines and how this affects current open requisitions.
- For the QBR talking points: include a line for leaders to acknowledge team disruption and offer an office hour window with People ops next week.

I'll draft the FAQ and drop it to Confluence tonight.

Thanks all — great feedback. Action items I captured:
- Update wording: "leadership layers" instead of "manager layers" (done)
- Add contact list + People Ops office hours (Jonas to draft FAQ; Stephanie to run office hours schedule)
- Clarify compensation phase-in language and ask Legal if we should word as "subject to local laws" (Priya to loop Legal)
- Laura to build the all-hands slide; I will provide notes for the presenter script.

Plan: incorporate changes tonight and circulate final pre-read tomorrow morning (11/6) for sign-off.

Priya

Subject: Re: Draft: Role lattice announcement + Q4 OKR check-in & QBR talking points (Final pre-read)

Priya / team —

Thanks for turning this around quickly. I reviewed the updated pre-read and I have three quick asks before we send to the broader company tomorrow morning:

1) Add a single-sentence "net impact" summary for each org (Sales, Product, Eng, Ops) so leaders can quickly repeat it.
2) For the slide deck, make the org-chart animation optional for accessibility (static image fallback).
3) Confirm that the FAQ includes: promotion timeline, effect on compensation bands, and how open reqs are handled.

If the above are in the final file by 10:00am PT tomorrow, consider this approved from my side. Great work.

Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: role-lattice-v2-final.pdf (pdf)]
